meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把记忆数据库同步到 cmem.ai 账号，检查同步状态，并写入连接设置，且不会泄露同步令牌。
howto.when: 当你说“set up cloud sync”、“sync my memories”、“cloud backup”等，或要求备份记忆数据库时触发。

say.text: 设置 cloud sync 云同步
检查我的记忆同步状态
say.note: 查询设备号、待同步数量等。
需提供令牌、用户ID和Hub网址。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check cloud sync status, configure the connection, and sync your memory database to cmem.ai via SyncHub, without exposing the token.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cloud backup", or ask to back up your memory database.

say_en.text: Back up my memories to cmem.ai.
say_en.note: Needs token, user ID, and Hub URL.
